reels.title: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics

editorial_notes.reasoning: GreenWAM perfectly aligns with the high-velocity robotics_tamp category (1.24x multiplier) and offers a compelling narrative about how robots perceive reality through world models.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How do robots build a mental map of our chaotic world before they even take their first step?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A robot playing a 'what-if' simulation game in its head, like a chess grandmaster visualizing every possible move on the board before touching a piece.
